notes.title: Patch 1.2 - Speech Bubble Display Revision
notes.content:
Hello Friends,

It's been brought to our attention that a small number of players have experienced an engine bug that resulted in speech bubble text getting stuck and not displaying correctly. We've implemented a work around that we hope remedies this issue, so that all players can experience the dialogue as intended.

Sincere apologies to anyone affected by this bug, which unfortunately didn't rear its ugly head until release!

Thanks for playing!

Imaginary Friends Games
